verdict.rationale: No first-party acceptable-use or anti-abuse policy appears in the pack. The only trace is a community report that Hyperbrowser added an 'ethical scraping' page to its docs (comm-9). That same commenter, and comm-8, note that users cannot actually honor robots.txt or limit request rates, so the page's force over the stealth and CAPTCHA features is unclear. missing for 10: a first-party acceptable-use policy or terms text, explicit rules on permitted uses of stealth mode and CAPTCHA solving, a documented abuse-reporting and enforcement process, independent corroboration of the policy's content.
